⚠️ Stitched 4-Cloud Multi-Vendor Stack ($959,900/mo = $11.52M/yr!)

• Copying data across S3, GCS, Snowflake & Neo4j incurs massive egress & ELT MAR bills
• Divergent Delta vs. Iceberg metadata copies create governance & permission drift
2. Always-On BI SQL Warehouse & Edition Multiplier Tax ($216,300/mo)
• DirectQuery from 48,000 users forces multi-cluster XL/2XL Warehouses to run 24x7
• Snowflake Business Critical (~1.5x) & Photon DBU multipliers compound compute burn
3. In-Memory DRAM Vector Cluster Tax ($172,200/mo · 12.45 TB RAM)
• Pure-memory HNSW indexes across Mosaic/Cortex/OpenSearch cost 26.2x more than SSD
• Siloed from enterprise M365 Copilot & Power BI semantic layer
4. Perfect-Square $193,600/mo (440²!) Per-User BI Viewer Seat Tax
• First time active viewer count breaks >40,000 (40,140 viewers across 48,000 users!)
• Per-seat Looker / Tableau / QuickSight licensing penalizes enterprise-wide data democratization
• Stitched 4-Cloud Cost: $959,900/mo ($11.52M/yr) vs. Fabric $21,480/mo
• Net Savings with Microsoft Fabric: -$938,420/mo (-97.8% · 44.7x Advantage!)
SA Selection Rule (R347 · Scenario MP): Standardize Greenfield on Fabric; embrace Brownfield via OneLake Zero-Copy Coexistence.
